items.claim: Amanda has faced a much higher level of competition than her opponent.
Lemos possesses greater power and will land heavier shots.
items.quote: I think she's going to have the bigger shots.

items.claim: Lemos leaves her chin exposed in the air, representing a major technique issue.
items.quote: that chin is just floating out there in the air. It is a bad bad bad technique issue

items.claim: Tinara has high volume and activity, but lacks substance against higher-level competition.
items.quote: there's a lot of volume there's a lot of activity. I just I just don't think there's a whole lot of substance to it once you move up to a certain point.

items.claim: Tai Miller has a significant reach advantage and knows how to use it.
items.quote: Ty Miller's got the reach. Seems to know how to use it.
